offer.text: I'd love to bake a cake but I've nothing to bake with. Could you bring me 6 eggs from the coop?

accept.text: Wonderful! It's been an age since I had a treat.

in_progress.text: Any eggs for my little cake?

ready.text: Six whole eggs! I can almost smell it baking already.

complete.text: I'll save you the first slice, I promise!
